safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tried E45 cream and antihistamines with minimal relief.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated only states an OTC cream (name unclear) was tried and not helpful; it does not include that it was specifically E45 nor that antihistamines were tried with minimal relief.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient specifically tried E45 and antihistamines (with minimal benefit) slightly reduces the precision of the prior-treatment history, but it is unlikely to change immediate management of suspected contact dermatitis beyond routine advice and topical therapy.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold lists metformin; generated does not document metformin or any prescribed/regular medication.
